# ovirt_network (Resource)

The ovirt_network resource creates and manages logical networks in oVirt.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ovirt_network" "test" {
  name          = "my-network"
  datacenter_id = var.datacenter_id
  description   = "My logical network"
  comment       = "Managed by Terraform"
  vlan          = 100
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `datacenter_id` (String) Datacenter to create this network in.
- `name` (String) User-provided name for the network.

### Optional

- `comment` (String) User-provided comment for the network.
- `description` (String) User-provided description for the network.
- `vlan` (Number) VLAN tag for the network (1-4094).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) oVirt ID of this network.
